description: Save a financing link the shop works with, shown on quotes at or above its minimum (owner or office). Up to 3 live links. Doing Work does not process financing or charge any fee for it. The link goes to the shop's own financing company.

label.description: What the customer sees on the button, such as Goodleap or Synchrony.

min_total_minor.description: Show this link only when the quote total (or the chosen option) is at least this many cents. Null means no minimum.

note.description: Optional short note under the button. Null clears it.

position.description: 1, 2 or 3. Leave out to take the next open spot.

url.description: An https address at the financing company. Placeholder and reserved names (example.com, example.net, example.org, .example, .test, .invalid, localhost) and raw IP addresses are refused. Doing Work does not open it.

name: financing_save

min_total_minor.description: Show this link when the quote total is at least this many cents. Null means no minimum. Doing Work does not charge this.
